payload.core_mechanism_summary: Count zero bits in 6-bit binary representation of each character, then compute 3^total_zero_bits mod 1e9+7.
payload.rationale: Solution uses bitwise analysis: each bit position independently yields 3 possibilities for 0 bit, 1 for 1 bit. Total ways = 3^(number of zero bits across all characters). No DP, just counting.
